summary: G-III Apparel Group filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to disclose a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share declared by its Board on May 26, 2026, payable July 8, 2026 to holders of record June 22, 2026. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return (beyond a routine dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. It is a routine dividend announcement that does not qualify as a special situation; thus correctly categorized as None.
